text:
Dana: DeltaPrime asked for a firm launch window in 5 weeks. Requests: tenant KMS, burst-to-120 QPS for 45s, and a 95ms p95 for short prompts. We need a single launch-playbook and owners. Call out absolute blockers vs negotiable tradeoffs.

Ike: Runtime quick take: hot-pool + cold-start microservice needed. Absolute blockers: reserved hot slots + model-swap API. Negotiable: quantization level (8-bit default; 4-bit after ML sign-off). I estimate engineering work ~10 business days to ship hot-pool.

Rhea: Infra: can reserve GPU capacity (floor 4xA100 or 8xA10s). Need dedicated subnet and NAT egress IPs for customer allowlist. Blocker: we need SKU confirmation by Tue to lock the capacity. Also need 1.5TB NVMe for cache.

Vik: Security: tenant KMS via HSM is required. Blocker until attestation flow and rotation policy are in place. Shadow mode ok for perf but NO live keys without attestation and SecOps signoff. Also require tenant RBAC mapping and audit retention policy.

Tess: SRE: propose SLOs for pilot: p95 <= 95ms on short prompts, p99 <= 420ms, error_rate < 0.35%. Canary ramp suggestion: phase-0 shadow 10% -> phase-1 10% live keys -> phase-2 40% -> 100%. Automated rollback triggers on error_rate or latency breach. Need oncall coverage for live-key phase for 72h.

Omar: Finance: reserve infra + HSM adds ~$15k/mo. If DeltaPrime signs a 6-month commitment we can amortize and provide a discount. Product should lead the contractual ask.

Maya: ML: 4-bit quant likely okay but accuracy impact depends on prompt mix. Need a 2k prompt sample from DeltaPrime. Eval window ~5 business days. If metric drop >1% we hold the 4-bit path.

Ike: Draft minimal launch playbook (proposed):
```
launch_playbook_delta:
  owners:
    product: Dana
    runtime: Ike
    infra: Rhea
    security: Vik
    sre: Tess
    ml: Maya
    finance: Omar
  gates:
    - infra_reserved
    - hsm_attestation_or_shadow_plan
    - perf_p95_within_target_at_10pct
    - runbook_and_oncall_confirmed
    - cost_terms_agreed
  canary_phases:
    phase0_shadow: 10% (measure perf + metrics)
    phase1_live_keys: 10% (post-attestation)
    phase2_expand: 40% -> 100% (if gates pass)
  rollback:
    immediate_route_switch_to_hosted_on_alert
  monitors: [p95_latency, p99_latency, error_rate, cpu_util, kv_hitrate]
  alert_triggers:
    - error_rate > 0.35% sustained 5m
    - p95 > 120ms sustained 10m
```

Rhea: Infra asks: to support 120QPS burst we need to hold +2 GPUs for headroom (cost +$5k/mo). If product commits to 6mo term we can pre-book these with preferred pricing. Need confirmation by EOD Fri.

Vik: Security process: I'll need an integration smoke test that calls KMS attestation endpoints and verifies signed tokens. Also need a PR with rotation policy + threat model. No live-key phase until checklist is green.

Tess: Runbook stub:
```
runbook_delta:
  checks: p50/p95/p99, error_rate, key_errors
  initial_actions:
    - on p95 spike: notify runtime & infra
    - on KMS errors: revert to hosted-keyflow or shadow mode
    - on sustained error_rate breach: automatic rollback
  oncall: [tess, runtime_primary, infra_primary]
```

Dana: Can we get firm dates? DeltaPrime expects a canary in 5 weeks. Proposed timeline: perf+evals weeks 1-2, infra reserve by week 1 end, attestation window week 3, shadow canary week 4, live-key canary week 5 if green. Owners agree?

Ike: Agree with timeline, but note hot-pool dev needs at least 8 business days (within that perf window). I'll post a perf plan Monday.

Maya: I'll need the 2k prompt set by Wed to run quant evals. If customer can't provide, we'll use sim prompts but note lower fidelity.

Omar: I'll draft two pricing options: (A) 6mo commit with +2 GPU included; (B) no commit, 10% shadow-only start and higher per-request rate. Sharing numbers by Thu.

Rhea: I'll tentatively hold the GPU SKU for 72 hours pending product confirmation. Posting exact SKUs in-thread.

Vik: Security caveat: if DeltaPrime restricts pen-test access we must keep live keys off and run only shadow performance canary. Call this out in the SOW.

Tess: Oncall rota: need 2 runtime engineers + 1 infra lead for first 72h of live keys. Nominate names?

Ike: I'll nominate Priya + Alex from runtime. Rhea please nominate infra lead.

Rhea: Kim will lead infra for the live ramp. I'll post contact and calendar invites.

deploy-bot: Automated: "Deployment window requested: 2026-06-03 02:00-05:00 UTC. Please confirm approvals and attach runbook."

Dana: Action items & deadlines (summary):
- DeltaPrime: provide 2k prompts + confirm 6mo ask by Wed
- Maya: run quant evals and post results by Fri
- Ike: perf plan Mon, hot-pool prototype week1-2
- Rhea: reserve GPUs + post SKUs by Fri EOD
- Vik: publish attestation checklist & rotation doc by Tue
- Tess: publish runbook + oncall rota by Tue
- Omar: pricing options by Thu
If any of the top gates slip, the canary moves by 1 week. Flag absolute blockers now. :white_check_mark: :eyes:
